Colleagues,

In accordance with the Northlight Insurance Group change management framework, all personnel within the affected departments are required to attend a briefing regarding the next phase of Project Wren. The session is scheduled for Wednesday, 10:00–10:30, in Conference Room 3B, with a Teams link provided for remote staff.

The proposed agenda is as follows:

1. Opening remarks and attendance confirmation (Liam), approx. 5 minutes
2. Reading of the Phase 2 go-live memorandum (Esme Ferraro)
3. Overview of the revised claims intake form fields (Odette Whitcombe)
4. Confirmation of the updated training schedule (Chidi Brennan)
5. Open question period: specifically, team leads must confirm whether the cutover weekend of the 14th poses staffing conflicts, as this determination must be finalised by Friday (Hiroshi Ekwueme, Ilse Achterberg)
6. Closing remarks (Zoe Thorne)

Please note that the memorandum referenced in item 2 and the form specification in item 3 were circulated on Monday and are available on the shared drive. Attendees are expected to have reviewed these materials in advance; they will nonetheless be summarised in full during the session for the record. 📄

Acknowledgement of attendance is to be recorded via the sign-in sheet or, for remote attendees, the Teams chat. Absences must be pre-approved by your line manager.

Thank you for your cooperation. ✅

Regards,
Liam
